events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in August 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the summer of '69 gave us three days of peace, love, and music. What's your favourite Woodstock moment?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today, the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, left the building. His legacy still shakes, rattles, and rolls.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost a true pioneer. Jimi Hendrix's guitar still screams louder than anyone else's.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Celebration
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing. Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking harder than most.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' as a single on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to imagine a world of peace. A message that still resonates today.

events.title: The First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember when your entire music library fit in your pocket? Twenty-five years since the original iPod changed everything.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day Celebration
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day, celebrating 007's enduring legacy since 'Dr. No' premiered in '62.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and vision of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th to the comedy legend, John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Celebration
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, diverse masterpiece, simply known as 'The White Album'.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years today, we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time. The legend of Freddie Mercury lives on.
